svg.text: py-spy record -o docs/profile_search.svg -- python -c from findex.store import open_index from findex.ranking import BM25, rank_documents with open_index('index.bin') as idx: terms = ['quotes', 'to', 'scrape'] docs = set(idx.doc_lengths.keys()) scorer = BM25() for _ in range(2000): rank_documents(terms, docs, idx, scorer, top_k=10)
